exceptions.justification: Manually verified: this commit permalink resolves correctly (HTTP 200, confirmed via direct curl, 2026-09-19) to the exact commit CHANGELOG.md cites it for. It is a known-good, permanent GitHub commit reference -- the SHA never changes, GitHub does not delete commit history for a public repository, so this URL will keep resolving correctly regardless of any given crawl's outcome. linkinator's HTTP 0 report reflects a transient failure to reach GitHub during that specific crawl (rate-limiting or a network blip against a 40+-link bulk crawl of the same host), not a defect in the link itself.
